title: The formal tangent of the K-theory class map is the generalized Loday-Quillen-Tsygan trace
difficulty_reason: H2: identifying the tangent K-theory complex with cyclic homology, as provided by the existing excision framework, does not identify the actual morphism induced by the vector-bundle class map. The author compares the relative Volodin/Chern-character construction with Malcev homology and Chevalley-Eilenberg complexes, transports that comparison through pointed nonunital monoidal linearization and the Beck-Chevalley transformation, and proves that the remaining tangent morphism is the reduced-CE/abelian-Lie adjunction unit. The latter identification uses geometric realization, the filtered Beilinson heart, coalgebra full faithfulness and a functorial scalar-idempotent/ nonzero normalization argument. This map-level compatibility core exceeds a routine consequence of a homology isomorphism; all earlier excision and named deformation-theoretic inputs remain explicitly supplied/attributed rather than counted again.

editorial_notes: Count exact author Theorem4.2.1/keythm:compLQT once. Tangent-BGL Lemma4.1.4, CE-comparison Lemma4.2.2 and unit-identification Lemma4.2.4 are its supporting core, not extra IDs.

Keep A a connective unital dg-algebra over a fixed field k of characteristic0, Ac_A(B)=B tensor_k A on Artinian commutative dg k-algebras, and the relative pointed BGL/K functors. No extension to arbitrary unbounded or merely H-unital A is added to this trace theorem.

The morphism is the specified map gl_infinity(A)[1] -> theta(HC^k_bullet(A)[1]) in shifted dg-Lie algebras, homotopic to the authors generalized LQT trace. Preserve all author reduced/unreduced CE and shift conventions.
The formal tangent is obtained by forcing Schlessinger conditions/abelian formalization. Do not replace it by a naive dual-number fiber or the separate Hochschild-valued Goodwillie derivative.
Pointed augmentation ideal bAc_A, not the unpointed functor Ac_A, is used for the monoidal CE linearization. Preserve this and the old2055 H-unital excision/composite-map hypotheses.
Theorem1/Corollary3.1.3, lambda compatibility, QCQS scheme/Picard applications and explicitly unproved derivative Remark3.1.6 remain original related context, not new separately counted results.
All author diagrams, cited Malcev/Goodwillie/Lurie/Beilinson inputs and original formulas are retained without normalization or assistant proof repair.

Source gl_infinity(A)[1], target theta(HC_bullet^k(A)[1]) and ambient shifted dg-Lie infinity category are those in the author statement; the conclusion is homotopy of these specified maps, not only equality on homology.

The CE comparison uses pointed bAc_A and nonunital monoidal compatibility, preserving reduced versus unreduced CE and original shifts.
The residual adjunction-unit identification is supplied through geometric realizations, filtered coalgebra full faithfulness, Yoneda classification and the nonzero scalar-idempotent conclusion.
No naive tangent/Goodwillie derivative substitution, positive-characteristic/base-ring extension, nonconnective trace theorem, or blanket universal-central-extension statement is added.
